children: UK home improvement retailer's H1 revenue rose 2.1% year-on-year to £865.3 mln
Adjusted pretax profit up 1.1% to £27.6 mln
Basic EPS fell 4.4% due to prior year's lower effective tax rate
Wickes expects to meet consensus forecasts of about 10% growth in 2026 adjusted PBT
Company reports Q3 trading so far shows mid-single-digit LFL revenue growth in Retail
Wickes expects to benefit from lower business rates and productivity plan in H2 2026
RETAIL VOLUME GROWTH - Co said higher volumes in Retail drove revenue up 0.8% despite price deflation and flat DIY sales
TRADEPRO MEMBERSHIP - TradePro sales rose 5% as active members increased to 671,000
DESIGN & INSTALLATION PROJECTS - Delivered sales in Design & Installation grew 5.7% as customers responded to enhancements in kitchen and bathroom ranges
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the home improvement products & services retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Wickes Group PLC is GBp250.00, about 41.6% above its September 14 closing price of GBp176.60
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
Sept 14 - Essar buys UK petrol station operator SGN Retail, adds 118 sites
Sept 14 - UK government seeks to acquire insolvent specialist steelmaker
Sept 14 - UK government hosts meeting with business leaders to discuss growth
